construction_rule: Every negative starts from its named valid control and carries exactly one predicate defect. Recompute dependent copies, keys, hashes and post-state with the actual shared owner helper, preserving the target defect; never let unrelated failures stand in for it. Schema-layer negatives run at that layer before downstream joins. Integrated negatives repair all non-target invariants.
duplicate_rule: Only the same field and same predicate enforced at several sites is a duplicate set. Prove each site individually, then all sites. Shared keywords, refusal codes and enforcement sites do not merge predicates. Use scripts/pm_guard_isolation.py, never lane-local machinery.
eager_reference_rule: Resolve all refs/branches on startup and enumerate every inherited assertion before phase-2 coverage is called complete. The explicit local-schema inventory below is a minimum; add the shared tool resolved inventory of owner request/native/envelope/receipt/token schemas, including each conditional predicate separately.
